'''Trif''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] who defected and joined the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].

==Biography==
Trif served both as a staff [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under [[Fenn Shysa]] and as a soldier during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. During that conflict, shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he joined a fleet that gathered at the planet [[Godo]], where he, along with fellow pilots [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Fenn Shysa]], [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], and [[Maggie]], sided with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the standoff between the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance fleet]] and the [[Godoan/Legends|Godoans]]. Later, he was part of a small team sent to infiltrate the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] base on [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] during the [[Battle of Saijo|last battle]] of the war.
